about.title: About the project
about.quoteText: «Learning from the past, from history, we were always told, meant securing the future. Perhaps this, the forgetting of our history, has been our collective sin — mine, that of the village where I was born, and that of so many other villages».
about.quoteAttribution: Alejandro Cabrero Durán, foreword to Historia de un pueblo morañego (Cabezas del Pozo), by Joaquín Ruano López
about.intro: <marca>Tú no me olvides</marca> was born so that this forgetting doesn't happen. It is a platform to document, preserve and share the cultural heritage of the villages of depopulated rural Spain. Every point on the map is a village with a history, with voices that once lived there, and with a memory that deserves to be told.
about.body: <marca>Tú no me olvides</marca> offers an on-site digital guide: a voice that accompanies the traveller, Spanish or international, during their visit to the village, uncovering its points of interest one by one and narrating their peculiarities, anecdotes and secrets. No app to download. No registration. Just scan the QR code and listen.
about.body2: It doesn't talk about history. It tells stories. Of lives, of memories, of curiosities that turn a walk through its streets into something unique. A whisper that carries you back in time.
about.body3: But <marca>Tú no me olvides</marca> isn't only an audioguide. Every locality that joins the project gets a complete tourism website: its points of interest with a page and audioguide, its documented routes, its businesses, and its calendar of festivals and events. All positioned online, so that travellers looking for an authentic destination can find the village before they arrive.
about.body4: And, finally, something very few towns have: real data about their visitors. Every QR code anonymously logs how many people scan it, when, and where they come from. For the first time, a village with no tourist office can know who is visiting and what interests them.
about.body5: Because every village has a story that deserves to be told. <marca>Tú no me olvides</marca> is here to tell it.
about.metaTitle: About the project — rural heritage & memory
about.metaDescription: Tú no me olvides brings out the tourism value of rural Spain and towns waiting to be discovered: a digital tourist office, a guide and a shop window.

hero.title: Tú no me olvides
hero.subtitle: We rescue the stories of rural Spain's villages and put them on the map.
hero.paragraph: We research, narrate and digitise the heritage of towns that deserve to be discovered. An on-site digital guide that accompanies visitors point by point, telling the secrets of each place.

homeIntro.title: Everything a town needs to show what it offers
homeIntro.intro: This isn't only about heritage. It's everything that makes a town unique: natural landscapes, routes, festivals and cultural traditions, gastronomy, tourist accommodation. Every locality that joins the project gets a complete digital platform that turns it into a real tourist destination.
homeIntro.officeTitle: A digital tourist office open 24 hours
homeIntro.officeBody: A tourism website of its own with everything the town offers: heritage, history, nature, local businesses. Each point with its own page, photograph and first-person audioguide.
homeIntro.guideTitle: A professional guide on every corner
homeIntro.guideBody: A QR code at each point of interest plays the audioguide: visitors hear the story of that place as if an expert guide were right beside them. Nothing to download, no sign-up.
homeIntro.venuesTitle: A shop window for its resources
homeIntro.venuesBody: Restaurants, bars, rural accommodation and local produce shops. Everything a visitor needs to make the most of the experience, while driving a sustainable local economy that helps keep the village alive.
homeIntro.dataBody: The council knows how many people visit each spot and where they come from. Anonymous, GDPR-compliant data.
